name: data-table-tanstack-router
title: DataTable TanStack Router Adapter
description: URL-backed DataTable state adapter for TanStack Router search params.

meta.searchParams: Use validateDataTableSearch in route validateSearch, then pass Route.useSearch() and useNavigate({ from: Route.fullPath }) to useDataTableRouter.
meta.stateMapping: page and perPage map to TanStack pagination; sort maps to sorting; filters maps to columnFilters; visibility maps to columnVisibility.
meta.limitations: The adapter keeps row selection local and does not implement server fetching, virtualization, saved views, or advanced filter builders.

parity.tanstackRouter: First-class comparison is TanStack Router: the adapter maps validated search params to pagination, sorting, filters, and visibility state while row selection stays local. Gaps: server fetching, route loader integration, saved views, debounced URL writes, and complex filter serialization remain follow-up work.
parity.tanstackTable: Complements the DataTable kit by keeping TanStack Table state URL-addressable without replacing table behavior. Gaps: no virtualization, no server-side pagination contract, and no global table preference persistence.
